subtitle.create: Define a new policy with a unique Policy ID, category and constraints.
subtitle.edit: Edit the policy and its constraints.

sections.categoryHint: Choose whether the policy governs access to or usage of the data.
sections.constraintsHint: Add one or more constraints. With multiple constraints, choose whether all (AND) or at least one (OR) must be met.

policyId.label: Policy ID
policyId.hint: Enter a unique ID without spaces after it (e.g. geodata-access-2027).

palette.title: Add constraint
palette.subtitle: Choose from the constraints available for the selected category.

logicalOperator.label: Combination of constraints
logicalOperator.hint: Defines how multiple constraints are combined.

OR.label: OR
OR.description: At least one constraint must be met.

constraint.empty: No constraints added yet. Without constraints this policy allows everything.

DATE_RANGE.label: Time period
DATE_RANGE.hint: Choose a start date from today onwards. For a period that is already running, the start date is kept and the end date can be extended.

PARTICIPANT_DID.label: Participants (did:web)
PARTICIPANT_DID.hint: Confirm with Enter or comma. Several DIDs can be pasted at once.

DATA_SUBSET.empty: No data subsets selected yet. Choose a kind, enter a name and add it.

hint.field: Name of the field, e.g., materialName
hint.attribute: Name of the attribute, e.g., color

DATA_SUBSET.alwaysApplies: This constraint always applies in addition, even with OR combination. Filtering is done by the delivering service.

CREDENTIAL_ATTRIBUTE.expertHint: For attributes not offered above. Requires the full type IRI of the credential and the path in the credentialSubject.
CREDENTIAL_ATTRIBUTE.attributePathHint: Path in the credentialSubject, e.g. roles[0] or site.accessLevel

ACCESS.label: Access Policy
ACCESS.description: Governs who is allowed to access the data.

CONTRACT.label: Contract Policy
CONTRACT.description: Governs under which conditions the data may be used.

DATE_RANGE.label: Time period
DATE_RANGE.description: Validity limited to a period from start to end date.
DATE_RANGE.legalText: The usage right applies only within the given time period.

PARTICIPANT_DID.label: Participant selection
PARTICIPANT_DID.description: Only the listed participants (did:web) satisfy the policy.
PARTICIPANT_DID.legalText: Only the explicitly named participants may access the data.

DATA_SUBSET.label: Data subset
DATA_SUBSET.description: Only the selected parts of a dataset (fields, attributes, submodels, records) are provided.
DATA_SUBSET.legalText: Only the explicitly named parts of the dataset are provided.

CREDENTIAL_ATTRIBUTE.label: Membership & credentials
CREDENTIAL_ATTRIBUTE.description: Only participants with certain membership attributes, e.g. partner type or work packages.
CREDENTIAL_ATTRIBUTE.legalText: The data consumer must hold verifiable credentials that satisfy the given rules.

summary.isAnyOf: Work packages: at least one of {{values}}

legalDescription.unrestricted: This policy contains no restrictions. Access to and usage of the provided data is permitted without limitation.
legalDescription.introAccess: Access to the provided data is only permitted under the following conditions:
legalDescription.introContract: Usage of the provided data is only permitted under the following conditions:
legalDescription.introAccessAnyOf: Access to the provided data is permitted if at least one of the following conditions is met:
legalDescription.introContractAnyOf: Usage of the provided data is permitted if at least one of the following conditions is met:
legalDescription.introAlwaysApplies: Irrespective of the above conditions, the following applies in all cases:

memberType.isAnyOf: partner type is one of the following: {{values}}
memberType.isNoneOf: partner type is none of the following: {{values}}

workpackages.isAnyOf: involved in at least one of the work packages {{values}}
workpackages.isNoneOf: involved in none of the work packages {{values}}

clause.dateRange: The granted permission is time-limited and applies exclusively within the period from {{start}} to {{end}}. Before the start and after the end of this period, any usage of the data is prohibited.
clause.participantDid: The data consumer must be one of the following participants, identified by their did:web identity: {{dids}}. Any usage of the data by other participants is prohibited.
clause.dataSubset: Only the following parts of the dataset are provided to the data consumer: {{selectors}}. The permission does not extend to any other part of the dataset; their usage is prohibited.
clause.credentialAttribute: The data consumer must hold verifiable credentials issued by trusted issuers that satisfy all of the following rules: {{rules}}. If a credential or attribute is missing, any usage of the data is prohibited.
